name: Perry's Tot Navy Strength Gin
history: 1833 | Matthew C. Perry helps found the Brooklyn Navy Yard's Naval Lyceum (namesake)
1841 | Perry becomes Commandant of the Brooklyn Navy Yard (to 1843)
palate: Classic London Dry character, delicate juniper
notes: 'Tot' is a British naval measure of spirit. Full botanical list not given. Brooklyn location per producer name; Difford's says only 'USA'.
